name: zepp-apps
description: Zepp OS watch face and mini apps for the Amazfit Cheetah (Square): an app-launcher watch face, a calorie/protein tracker, a weather app a daily task list, a water reminder and a vibration tester

scripts.build: npm run build:watchface && npm run build:launcher && npm run build:nutrition && npm run build:weather && npm run build:tasks && npm run build:water && npm run build:buzz
scripts.screens: node --import ./test/support/register.mjs tools/preview.mjs watchface && node --import ./test/support/register.mjs tools/preview.mjs launcher && node --import ./test/support/register.mjs tools/preview.mjs nutrition && node --import ./test/support/register.mjs tools/preview.mjs weather && node --import ./test/support/register.mjs tools/preview.mjs tasks && node --import ./test/support/register.mjs tools/preview.mjs water && node --import ./test/support/register.mjs tools/preview.mjs buzz
